manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 230
text:
Page 001
001-1. GONG PING MIGHT BE ENVIOUS THAT THERE'S SOME- ONE THINKING ABOUT YOUR FUTURE.
001-2. AS LONG AS WE DON'T BREAK UP, IT'S ALL AN INVESTMENT TOWARDS YOU BE- COMING A FAMILY MEMBER.
001-3. YOU'RE THAT GOOD TO ME?
001-4. IT'SNOT THAT IM THAT GOOD TO YOU, WE'VE BECOME'A WHOLE NOW,
001-5. I CAN'T JUST THINK ABOUT HOW I CAN IMPROVE MYSELF AND THENTAKEYOU WITH ME AFTER.I SHOULD TAKE YOUWITH ME AND CONSIDER HOW THE TWOOF US CAN LIVE A BETTER LIFE.
001-6. THAT IS TO SAY,
001-7. IF I'M GOOD TO YOU, THEN I'M BEING GOOD TO MYSELF.IFYOULIVE WELL, THENIT'S GOODFOR BOTH OF US.

Page 002
002-1. THEN WHY AREN'T YOU STUDYING?

Page 003
003-1. I'M GOING TO MAKE LUNCH.
003-2. AHEM...SO IF SHE'S INTERESTED IN ME, YOU DON'T HAVE TO BE JEALOUS.
003-3. SHE'S JUST TRYING TO MAKE FRIENDS, WHAT'S THERE'TO BE JEALOUS ABOUT?
003-4. 心恭香 动
003-5. UNLESS...
003-6. YOU REALLY DO LIKE HER HIGH HEELS?
003-7. IDON'T!
003-8. Elec
003-9. THEN EVERY- THING IS FINE,
003-10. I'LL BEAT YOU UP IF YOU DARE TO LIKE IT.

Page 004
004-1. FORLITTLE JIANG HE, THIS IS NOT NORMAL,
004-2. FORMORDERN PEOPLE, INTRODUCING YOUR BOYFRIENDTO YOUR BESTFRIEND JIS COMPLETELY NORMAL.
004-3. A NORMALPROCEDURE WOULD BE INVITING MY GIRLFRIEND'S BEST FRIEND TO A NICE RESTAURANT FOR DINNER,
004-4. JUDGE- MENT BEGINS
004-5. THEN I WOULD SHOWCONCERN SO THAT HER BEST FRIEND CAN GETA GOOD FIRST IMPRESSION.
004-6. INTHE END...
004-7. I WAS HOLDING A THERMOSCUP AND BRAGGING INTHESUN WITH THE SECURITY GUARDATTHE GATE?
004-8. NO NO NO, IT DOESN'TMATTERANY- MORE.WHATISHOULD 1 A LAMENT ABOUT IS THE ACCELERATEDGROWTH OFLITTLE JIANG HE.

Page 005
005-1. THE MORE THINGS SHE'S EXPOSED TO, THE FASTER SHE INTEGRATES.
005-2. THE GIRL WHO WAS DRENCHED IN RAIN WHILE HOLDING A SWORD IN THE HALLWAY,
005-3. CANALREADY JOKE AROUND WITH ME.
005-4. I'LL BRING UNCLE ZHAO SOME TEA.FRIENDS SHOULD TREATEACHOTHER THE WAYTHEY WOULD LIKETO BE TREATED THEMSELVES.

Page 006
006-1. WHY ARE YOU TAKING OUT TEA LEAVES?
006-2. GIVING SOME TO UNCLE ZHAO.
006-3. YOU'RE GOING OUT FOR TEA THIS AFTERNOON?
006-4. MM, WANT TOGO WITH?
006-5. I PREFER SITTING WITH GIRLS.
006-6. SHE'S MAKING IT SOUND LIKE I ALWAYS LIKETOSIT WITHOLD MEN..
006-7. WHY ARE YOU BEING SO POLITE? YOU'RE ACTING LIKE WE'RE STRANGERS!
006-8. IT'S THE LEAST I SHOULD DO.

Page 007
007-1. AI, THIS KID! WHY DO YOU ACT LIKE ANOLD MANAT SUCH A YOUNG AGE? WHERE ARE YOUR FRIENDS?
007-2. THEY'RE BUSY, HOW CAN THEY BE AS FREE AS ME?
007-3. MOREOVER, I USUALLY DRINK ALCOHOL WITH THEM WHILEI DRINK TEAWITH YOU.I CAN'T DRINK ALCOHOL LIKE I USED TO ANYMORE, SINCEIT'S TIGHTLY CON- TROLLED.AREN'T ALL WOMEN LIKE THAT?
007-4. WHENWE FIRST GOT TOGETHER, SHE WAS QUITE OBEDIENT, BUT AFTER A WHILE, SHE JUST TURNED INTO A TIGER..

Page 008
008-1. HAHA! LOOK AT HOW SCARED YOU ARE! ￥
008-2. WHEN ARE YOU TWO GETTING MARRIED?
008-3. SOON,SOON, SHE ALREADY MET MY PARENTS,SO WITHIN TWO YEARS.
008-4. LET ME TELL YOU, WOMEN ARE LIKE THAT. SHE'S LIKE A KITTEN AT THE BEGINNING,BUT AS TIME GOES BY,SHE'LL BECOME ANNOYED WHEN THERE'S TOO MANY TRIVIAL THINGS. IF SHE BECOMES ANNOYED TOO MUCH,SHE'LL HAVE A BAD TEMPER. x++
008-5. THEN SOMETIMES YOU'LL FEEL LIKE LIKE, EH, WHY IS THIS DIFFERENT FROM BEFORE? HOW COME THEY BECAME A DIFFER- ENT PERSON?
008-6. IS ALNTY LIKE THAT?
008-7. I CAN'T...DO ANYTHING ABOUT THE SMOKING, BUT I CONCEDE TO HER ONEVERYTHING ELSE.

Page 009
009-1. I PRETENDNOT TO HEAR HER AND LET HER QUARREL, SINCE I'LL FEEL BETTER THAT WAY. OTHERWISE, WE WOULD QUARREL FOR A WHILE.
009-2. SO HOW LONG HAVE YOU TWO BEEN TOGETHER?
009-3. THREE YEARS.
009-4. IT SHOULD BE THREE YEARS..DON'T LET HER HEAR THAT, OTHERWISE SHE'LL GET ON ME AGAIN.
009-5. YOU DON'T REMEMBER?
009-6. IT WAS VERY VAGUE AT THE START,EVEN HOLDING HANDS WAS HARD!
009-7. AIYAH!I DIDN'T KNOW IF WE WERE TOGETHER ORNOT, BUT IT'S JUSTTHEN WESTARTED LIVING TOGETHER LATER.
009-8. WHEN WE HELD HANDS AT THAT TIME, WE WERE ALREADY TO- GETHER.WE HAD TO GET MARRIED TO LIVE TOGETHER. LOOK AT YOU TWO,GOT TOGETHER AFTERLIVING TOGETHER.

Page 010
010-1. WHATIF YOU TWO BREAK UP?
010-2. I'LLBE BEATEN TO DEATH BY HER.
010-3. AH. 小
010-4. UNCLE ZHAO, YOU'RE THINK- ING OF...
010-5. WE'RE HEADING OUT~
010-6. TAKE CARE OF YOUR- SELVES NOW.

Page 011
011-1. SHE'S NOT STUDYING TODAY EITHER.
011-2. YOU'RE BACK.
011-3. WHERE'D YOU GO TO HAVE FUN?
011-4. PINGPING AND I WENT SHOPPING, WATCHED A MOVIE, AND DRANK MILKTEA...

Page 012
012-1. THERE WERE CLAW MACHINES, BUT I DIDN'T GET ANYTHING.
012-2. IT'S OKAY~ YOU CAN TRY AGAIN NEXT TIME!
